name: Nebbiolo d'Alba

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Nebbiolo sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A DOC in the province of Cuneo for wine made from Nebbiolo, including a quality sparkling style.
